categories.name: build
categories.evidence: Matches 'Build system' label and updates Guix reproducible build manifests in contrib/guix and CI lint requirements.
categories.rationale: Enables native Guix builds on RISC-V architectures by updating time-machine and working around upstream test failures on riscv64. This adds architecture support for reproducible builds without impacting primary release platforms.
